display_name: High Peak — the Voodoo Boys' meeting ground
why: The venue is the scraped construction shelf of the unfinished High Peak resort in Dogtown (Luxor Heights): a container house, a truck, trash piles, cover objects and a ladder on the slope above Luxor Heights, where mq304 stages V's meeting with Jago Szabó and a Voodoo Boys delegation. In normal play the ground streams as ordinary world but nobody is there, because every occupant is spawned by mq304_jago / mq304_vdb_gameplay. This proposal restores the site as a live Voodoo Boys meeting ground: the six-goon delegation at their own lean/stand spots, a Voodoo Boys netrunner with them, Jago's bodyguard on post, the two Mahir vans they came in, and Jago himself as the man the meeting is for. It also holds the quest's invisible boundary fence off, so the site stays walk-in and walk-out.

open_questions: Check the six Voodoo Boys at the site: they should stand, lean on walls or chat around the container house, never crouch into cover or aim. Their AI spots are routine lean/stand and guard_stand, but no community area node maps entries to spots, so the pairing is inferred.
Check the boundary fence is off: walk off the meeting shelf toward the slope road and the cliff edge and make sure nothing invisible stops you. The two mq304_jago_boundaries variants must stay 0.
Check the two parked Mahir vans: they should sit level on the ground near the meeting, not floating, half-sunk, or parked across the only way in.

Check Jago: he should stand at the meeting on foot in a normal idle, not sit in a car or hold a driving pose. His spawn-set node could not be resolved offline and phase None is vanilla's default, so this is the least certain placement.
Check the netrunner: the Voodoo Boys netrunner should idle calmly with the group (talk spot) and not stand on a walk-to-scene spline or in a T-pose.
Check Jago's bodyguard: he should stand guard near the meeting point, weapon at rest, not in a combat crouch, and not where the dead-idle jago_01 spot used to be.
Check the anchor: on approach the tour breadcrumb _prox should flip. If the security-area device 17 m away never streams, the second activation is lost while the boot activation still fills the site.

communities.why: The whole six-entry Voodoo Boys delegation in its only phase, jago_meeting: three men and three women whose nearby AI spots (#ep1_mq304_ws_vdb_01..06, plus an extra _05_b guard stand) are routine lean-on-wall / stand-ground plus plain guard_stand, i.e. the group waiting around the site, not a combat line. This is the community vanilla switches on whole (entry None/phase None) from mq304_vdb_gameplay.

A Voodoo Boys netrunner is the highest-priority role in the owner's population rule, and a netrunner at a Voodoo Boys meet is exactly the faction's look. The phase is the entry's initial workspot-start phase, which no quest activates, so it reads as an ambient post rather than a scene. Its exact spot is unverified (no community area node), hence the tour check.

Jago's second bodyguard keeps his post at the meeting: meeting_spawn is the standing post phase, and its spot plays the plain patrolling guard_stand. The entry's sibling jago_01 is not used because its arrive spot plays a dead-idle workspot.
One of the two Mahir vans the Voodoo Boys drove in with; vanilla activates this entry in vdb_jago_meeting when the meeting starts, so the van belongs at the site for as long as the delegation does.
The second Mahir van, same vanilla activation as car_01; two vans read as a delegation that came in force.

spawn_sets.why: Jago Szabó is the man the site exists for in mq304 (the Voodoo Boys are his delegation) and he is alive in our timeline as Dogtown's head accountant and a leadership candidate. Vanilla uses the meeting's own #mq304_jago node here as the scene actor and only deactivates it, so activating it leaves him at the meeting without the scene. Flagged: the node is unresolved offline (venue_inferred) and phase None is vanilla's default state, so the tour must confirm he actually appears on foot.

variant_toggles.why: The two variants hold the quest's invisible fence: variant mq304_jago_boundaries contains the four gameWorldBoundaryNodes (building, cliff, top, entrance) and mq304_jago_boundaries_toggle the fifth (back). Both are enabledByDefault 0 in the streaming block, and mq304_jago raises them to 1 for the staged meeting; holding both at 0 keeps the site walk-in, walk-out in normal play.

proximity_wait.why: The venue drives no device of its own (its devices prefab holds only a forklift and a ladder), and it has no doors: it is an open construction shelf, so the way in is on foot from the Luxor Heights slope road. This is the nearest real device entity to the meeting spots (about 17 m), a security-area device in the always-streamed high_peak gameplay prefab, so it streams with the venue. It only gates the second (post-proximity) activation; the boot activation already populates the site.
